purpose: Deterministic analytical oracle for testing units, calculation plumbing, and future solver adapters. Not a building design or proof of code compliance.

model.idealization: Prismatic Euler-Bernoulli cantilever beam, fixed at x=0 and free at x=L, with a vertical point load P at the free end.
assumptions: no self-weight, buckling, lateral-torsional instability, connections, fire, fatigue, or material defects

interpretation.pass_means: The analytical reference computation and unit/shape checks match this declared example within the stated tolerance.
does_not_mean: A finite-element solver has been independently validated.
The beam is adequate for a real building.
Connections, supports, load combinations, stability, fire resistance, serviceability rules, material grades, or jurisdictional provisions have been checked.
